description.en: The detailed address where the gateway is located.
The ID of the region where the gateway is located, as defined by `http://lbs.amap.com/api/javascript-api/download`.
The name of the city where the gateway is located.

description.zh:
网关通信模式。取值：

- FULL_DUPLEX：全双工。

- HALF_DUPLEX：半双工。
description.en:
The communication mode of the gateway. Valid values:

- FULL_DUPLEX: full-duplex.

- HALF_DUPLEX: half-duplex.

description.zh: 自定义网关描述信息，长度不超过100个字符（一个中文汉字算一个字符）。
description.en: The custom description of the gateway. The description can be up to 100 characters in length. A Chinese character counts as one character.
The name of the district where the gateway is located.
The frequency band ID of the gateway.

description.zh: 网关经纬度所采用的坐标系统，可取值为**WGS_84**, **GCJ_02**。
description.en: The coordinate system used for the longitude and latitude of the gateway. Valid values: **WGS_84** and **GCJ_02**.
The unique identifier of the gateway.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Instance Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
自定义网关名称。

- 仅支持中文汉字、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）。

- 必须以中文汉字、英文字母或数字开头。

- 长度不超过30个字符，不少于4个字符（一个中文汉字算一个字符）。
description.en:
The custom gateway name.

- Only Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (\_) are supported.

- The name must start with a Chinese character, letter, or digit.

- The name must be 4 to 30 characters in length. A Chinese character counts as one character.

description.zh: 网关PinCode，用于确保录入者拥有该网关。
description.en: The PinCode of the gateway, which is used to verify that the registrant owns the gateway.
